purpose: Familiar painted UI artwork: four harbor place signs, three interchangeable Mochi portraits and twelve Tidekeeper ask icons

generator.tool: Codex CLI (`codex exec`, image_gen.imagegen built-in tool)
generator.cliVersionVerification: Verified with codex --version on 2026-11-14; the supplied UI generation records do not independently record the CLI version.

delivery: The delivered cream-backed PNG masters are preserved byte-for-byte. Before delivery, signs and portraits had only their connected exterior backdrop normalized to #F4EBD9 at original dimensions; ask icons were extracted, trimmed and normalized to an 878 px longest object dimension on 1254 px cream squares, as recorded per file. Runtime WebPs are produced by scripts/optimize-ui-assets.ts (see manifest.json): four-corner flood fill and tuned alpha edge cleanup; signs trimmed to 480 px wide; all three portraits use one shared crop from the union of their alpha bounds, fitted into 256x256 transparent squares; ask icons are trimmed, fitted to 84 px and centered on 96x96 transparent squares with a six-pixel minimum margin. The optimizer never resizes or modifies the masters.
